experiment_data.hypothesis: Qwen2.5-Math-7B Standard 20% pruned model (post-prune accuracy 18.5%) can recover to ~50-60% GSM8K accuracy via SFT, following the same recovery pattern observed in DeepSeek-R1. This validates cross-architecture generalizability of the pruning method.

spec.command: bash -c "source /root/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh && conda activate base && cd /root/recovery_aware_struct_prune && python src/sft_recovery.py --model_path /root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune/pruned_standard_20_qwen_math --output_dir /root/autodl-tmp/recovery_aware_struct_prune/sft_standard_20_qwen_math --num_train_epochs 2"
